## Construction and quantified theorem surface

All new theorem names are fully qualified below. `primitive_records_derive_fields` and `primitive_records_derive_source_probe` quantify arbitrary S,T with DecidableEq, source and fact inventories, exact use/receiving/target coordinates, the same R77 Choice, native Records and original annotation/row. Their explicit PrimitiveRecords premise consists of finite native reader equations and primitive record identities; construct evaluates this premise internally. Neither theorem assumes Incidence, Root, ownerSelection success or sourceProbe success. The R77 computed choice supplies global selection, same-use plan and parameter recipe. readRecords obtains the permission/root/child/fact from original owner records, and construct first computes the aligned choice then native records then validates every primitive check. No caller-supplied probe, registration or selected owner enters construct.

`assemble` returns the existing R66 Incidence with all five fields. `constructed_applies_r45` applies it to exact R45.extract and retains the original Name peel evidence. `constructBridged` adds R79 typed HIR→collected lookup; `bridged_target_in_collection` applies R79 under explicit OrderedRoots. The finite theorems demonstrate nonempty success, distinct Name=100/Apply=102, duplicate-preserving concrete row [7,7,11], parameter root=700 versus registered Lambda root=300, and the named rejections. The local/global mismatch still passes R77 alignment/choice and fails the native Lambda read. Foreign registration shares Function and entry image. Substituted registration/annotation permission, bad parameter recipe/Lambda recipe, duplicated slot-0/slot-2 facts and parameter-root substitution reject.

The first remaining R66 Root premise is sameArtifact s.artifact=n.artifact, followed by exact permission.entry=.effectRow n.state n.entryRow and BeforeAncestry on an actual native Physical/current slot, admission, relation, unique source root/drain and original occurrence-qualified fact. Then genuine ancestry and physical identity joins remain. Owner: primary source/native lane. No Root or physical join is claimed. Coverage omitted: universal success, whole-language extraction, original semantic source laws, effects hygiene, original A/B, soundness/principality/progress/termination and production. This finite Internal case excludes no constructor from the parent obligation.
